skills.name: delegate
skills.description: Before assigning work or choosing helpers, reuse the best-fitting profile or service, name one result owner, and choose a supported model for each handoff.

reminder.codex: delegate — Before handoff: one fitting owner, reusable profile or service, and supported model.
reminder.claude: brobot:delegate — Before handoff: one fitting owner, reusable profile or service, and supported model.

skills.name: hand-back
skills.description: During work or before completion, keep evidence findable, resolve required results and questions, and hand back once.

reminder.codex: hand-back — Before returning: resolve dependencies, keep evidence and report once.
reminder.claude: brobot:hand-back — Before returning: resolve dependencies, keep evidence and report once.

skills.name: split-work
skills.description: Before dividing an outcome, choose bounded pieces by project kind, outputs and dependencies; keep one owner responsible for integration.

reminder.codex: split-work — Before dividing: bounded pieces, dependencies and integration.
reminder.claude: brobot:split-work — Before dividing: bounded pieces, dependencies and integration.

skills.name: ask-and-wait
skills.description: When the person must answer or act, track the question or task, name what ends the wait, and manage the follow-up.

reminder.codex: ask-and-wait — When the person must answer or act: track it and name the wait.
reminder.claude: brobot:ask-and-wait — When the person must answer or act: track it and name the wait.

skills.name: remember
skills.description: Before unfamiliar work, after a tested reusable lesson, or on a memory request, use permitted saved methods and memory.

reminder.codex: remember — Before unfamiliar work or handback: use relevant methods; save tested lessons if allowed.
reminder.claude: brobot:remember — Before unfamiliar work or handback: use relevant methods; save tested lessons if allowed.

skills.name: add-a-capability
skills.description: When the needed tool is missing, check available tools and existing connections; propose a reviewed local build only if the person wants one.

reminder.codex: add-a-capability — When a tool is missing: existing connection first; build only if wanted.
reminder.claude: brobot:add-a-capability — When a tool is missing: existing connection first; build only if wanted.

skills.name: build-software
skills.description: Before building software or any file-changing script or command, name one owner and an independent checker and verify the result.

reminder.codex: build-software — Before building or file-changing code: owner and checker verify it.
reminder.claude: brobot:build-software — Before building or file-changing code: owner and checker verify it.
